# BountyRadar MCP

Ranked, agent-solvable bounty feed — score every bounty for solvability, freshness and competition, then serve a ranked feed agents can act on.

MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP; Bearer token required):
https://neeenja--bountyradar-mcp.apify.actor/mcp

Connect (hosted, no local install — Apify Standby):
claude mcp add bountyradar --transport http https://neeenja--bountyradar-mcp.apify.actor/mcp

Tools (Pay-Per-Event; initialize and tools/list are free):
- get_bounty_feed — ranked, agent-solvable bounty feed (billable $0.0005)
- search_bounties — filter by source / task / min-reward (billable $0.0010)
- get_bounty_detail — full bounty detail (free)
- score_bounty — explainable solvability / competition / freshness score (billable $0.0005)
- list_sources — list data sources (free)
- get_stats — aggregate stats across sources (billable $0.0005)
- subscribe_feed — in-memory alert subscription (billable $0.0005)

Data sources: Opire, BountyHub, ClawHunt, Algora, GitHub, validated security programs.
License: MIT. Detail + pricing: https://sartbot.com/bountyradar/
